drhp.expansion: The Company has exited manufacturing following the sale of its Single Super Phosphate plant at Mahad to Mangalore Chemicals and Fertilisers Limited (MCFL), consummated 30th September 2025, and does not have any operating business segments. It is currently an investment holding entity evaluating redeployment of capital into new business areas including manufacturing, trading and investments, and has obtained shareholder approval to amend its Memorandum of Association to permit mining activities, though no mining activities have commenced.

litigation.note: The Company received a SEBI Show Cause Notice dated 14th January 2025 alleging violations of SEBI LODR Regulations read with IND-AS-8, and SEBI PFUTP Regulations; it filed a settlement application, and vide Order dated 5 March 2026 the proceedings were disposed of upon payment of Rs. 1,19,92,500 towards settlement and acceptance of voluntary debarment for three months from trading in the securities market. Separately, the Regional Director (Western Region) ordered a Companies Act Section 206(5) inspection, and the RoC informed the Company (email dated 11th September 2025) that prosecution was sanctioned against the Company and its directors for violations of Sections 129, 179, 143 and 166 of the Companies Act, 2013; compounding applications have been submitted by the Directors/KMPs. (Source: Secretarial Audit Report, Annexure 'F' to the Board's Report.)
